spans.s: pron. a. (Used only in the dual) Both; उभौ तौ न विजानीतः [[
]]; [[Śi. 3. 8.]] [cf. Zend. uba.; Gr. amphi; L. ambo].

pron. a. 
(-यी f.) (Though dual in sense, it is used in the singular and plural only; according to some grammarians in the dual also) Both (of persons or things); यस्तद्वेदोभयं सह [[Īśop. 11]] उभयमप्यपरितोषं समर्थये [Page0475-2] [[Ś. 7]]; उभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः [[

]], 4. 224, 9. 34, 
-Comp. 
-अन्वयिन् a. Tending towards both, keeping connection with both. 
-अलंकारः (in Rhet.) A figure of speech, which sets off both the sense and sound. 
-अर्थम् ind. for a double object (for earthly prosperity and heavenly happiness also). 
-आत्मक a. belonging to both. 
-चर a. living in water and on land or in the air, amphibious. [[Mātaṅga

.]] 
(-रः) a class of birds who live both on land and in the air. 
-च्छन्ना (in Rhet.) A kind of enigma. 
-द्युः ind. 
__1 on both days. 
__2 the day past and to come. 
-पदिन् a. Having both Parasmai and Atmane pada. 
-भागहर a. 
__1 applicable to two objects. 
__2 taking two shares. 
(-रम्) a medicine that acts in two ways (both as an emetic and a purgative). 
-मुख a. two faced; a pregnant female. 
-विद्या two-fold sciences; i. e. religious knowledge and knowledge about worldly affairs. 
-विद्य a. of both kinds. 
-विपुला f. N. of a metre. 
-विभ्रष्ट a. losing both कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टः [[

.]] 
-वेतन a. receiving wages from both (parties), serving two masters, treacherous, perfidious; उभयवेतनो भूत्वा [[

.]] 
-व्यञ्जन a. having the marks of both sexes, hermaphrodite. 
-संभवः a. dilemma. 
-स्नातक a. one who has performed the prescribed ablutions after finishing both his time of studying and his vow. See Kullūka on [[
ind. Ved. In both ways; बृहस्पतिर्ब उभया न मृळात् [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-दत् a. having teeth on [Page0476-1] both sides. 
-विन् a. being on both sides, partaking of both. 
-हस्ति ind. as much as may be grasped with both hands; उभयाहस्त्या भर [[
ind. .__1 From both sides, on both sides, to both sides (with acc.) एतदनृतमुभयतः सत्येन परिगृहीतम् [[Bṛ.
.]] उभयतः कृष्णं गोपाः [[Sk.]] तज्जः पुनात्युभयतः पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् [[

.]] 
__2 In both cases. 
__3 In both ways; पुष्पिणः फलिनश्चैव वृक्षास्तूभयतः स्मृताः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-क्षुत् a. two-edged (Ved.). 
-दत्, -दन्त a. having a double row of teeth; पशून् मृगान् मनुष्यांश्र व्यालांश्चोभयतोदतः [[

.]] 
-पाश a. having trap on both sides. lit. and fig. सैषोभयतस्पाशा रज्जुर्भवति [[Mbh.]] on [[

.]] 
-प्रज्ञ a. one whose cognizance is directed both inwards and outwards. नान्तःप्रज्ञं न बहिःप्रज्ञं नोभयतः प्रज्ञं [[Māṇḍ.]] 
-भाष a. occurring both in parasmaibhāṣā and Ātmanebhāṣā. 
-मुख a. 
__1 looking either way. 2 two-faced (as a house &c). 
__2 Two-edged (a sword) पट्टीशात्मसमोहस्तबुध्नश्चोभयतो मुखः [[Śukra. 4. 1044.]] 
(-खी) a cow; (‘यावद्वत्सस्य पादौ द्वौ मुखं योऽन्यां च दृश्यते’ तत्काले उभयतो मुखी) [[

-7.]] 
-ह्नस्व a. (an accented vowel) produced by two short vowels.

.]] °उदात्त having an Udātta accent on both sides.
